summary.headline: Driver update service flow explains Intune and Autopatch roles
summary.summary: The architecture explanation states that Intune sends identities, policy, approvals, and pause commands; Autopatch configures Windows Update; devices provide diagnostic data and receive approved driver updates.
summary.adminImpact: Ensure diagnostic data, device check-in, and approval workflows are in place before relying on driver inventory and reports.

summary.headline: Critical CVE recommendations link to the consolidated expedited quality update workflow
summary.summary: When a vulnerability recommendation starts with Expedite at CVSS 9.0 or higher, the remediation agent now directs administrators to the expedite section of the Windows quality update policy guidance.
summary.adminImpact: For CVSS 9.0+ recommendations, use the quality update policy expedite workflow to deploy the fix immediately.

summary.headline: OfferReady validation directs administrators to feature update report access
summary.summary: Feature update policy guidance directs administrators to the Accessing feature updates reports location when confirming that devices reached OfferReady before proceeding.
summary.adminImpact: Verify all intended devices show OfferReady in the organizational report before continuing a feature update rollout.

summary.headline: Windows 11-ineligible device guidance links to feature update policy behavior
summary.summary: The Windows 10 guidance directs administrators to the feature update policy explanation of multiple policies targeting a device.
summary.adminImpact: Remove Windows 11-ineligible devices from the Windows 11 policy and assign an appropriate Windows 10 feature update policy.

summary.headline: Feature update deployments should use zero-day ring deferrals
summary.summary: Feature update guidance recommends setting Feature update deferral period to 0 so an update-ring deferral does not delay the feature update policy.
summary.adminImpact: Set feature update deferral to 0 in relevant update rings when moving devices through a feature update policy.
